name: conception-agent
description: 管理科研构思会话，调用原生 research_agent 的多来源文献检索 Skill，并支持用户主动反馈修改

display_description.en: Creates evidence-backed conceptions from multiple literature APIs with 10 verified references.
display_description.zh: 通过多来源真实文献 API，生成含 10 篇可核验参考文献的科研构思。

default_init_input.zh: 请根据我的研究方向生成一版构思，包含恰好 10 篇可核验参考文献，并整理成规划模块可直接接收的结构化结果
default_init_input.en: Create a research conception with exactly 10 verified references and structure it for direct use by the planning module

quick_inputs.en: Create a research conception with exactly 10 verified references and structure it for direct use by the planning module
quick_inputs.zh: 请根据我的研究方向生成一版构思，包含恰好 10 篇可核验参考文献，并整理成规划模块可直接接收的结构化结果

quick_inputs.en: Create a conception using arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and Crossref literature
quick_inputs.zh: 请结合 arXiv、Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex 和 Crossref 文献生成构思

quick_inputs.en: Revise the current conception from my feedback while preserving unaffected valid content
quick_inputs.zh: 请根据我的反馈修改当前构思，并保留未受影响且仍然有效的内容
